name: io.github.jusscubs/jev-conductor-router
title: Conductor Jev Router
description: Jev-gated router for Conductor cloud workspaces, exposed as a stdio MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CONDUCTOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for https://api.conductor.build. The user supplies this key. It is never bundled.

environmentVariables.name: ORBIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Orbio Jev decisions key. Tried first when set.

environmentVariables.name: ORBIO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Orbio origin. Defaults to https://api.orbio.so.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Optional primary Jev provider: orbio, openrouter, or typesafe.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_FALLBACK_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Optional single fallback provider. When unset, the remaining configured providers are tried in the default order.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Jev model id. Defaults to typesafe/jev-1.13.
